content.value_statement: Database changes can cause downtime, data loss, and failed deployments. This skill guides migration plans, ORM examples, rollback steps, and zero-downtime sequencing.
actual_capabilities: Shows Sequelize, TypeORM, and Prisma migration patterns.
Outlines safe schema transformation steps for columns and types.
Explains data transformation migrations with parameterized updates.
Describes transaction-based and checkpoint rollback strategies.
Breaks zero-downtime rollout work into compatible deployment phases.
Notes cross-database differences between PostgreSQL and MySQL JSON types.
limitations: Provides guidance and examples, not an executable migration runner.
Does not inspect live database state or validate production data.
Examples require adaptation to each schema, ORM version, and deployment process.
Does not replace backups, staging tests, monitoring, or database owner approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare an ORM Migration
use_cases.description: Plan a Sequelize, TypeORM, or Prisma migration with an up path and rollback path.

use_cases.title: Reduce Deployment Downtime
use_cases.description: Sequence additive schema changes, backfills, application deploys, and cleanup work.

use_cases.title: Review Data Transformation Risk
use_cases.description: Check migration steps for backups, transactions, NULL handling, and rollback readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Migration Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple schema change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a database migration that adds [column] to [table] using [ORM]. Include the up migration, rollback approach, and staging test checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Convert an ORM Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for moving between ORM formats.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to convert this migration from [source ORM] to [target ORM]. Preserve schema behavior, constraints, rollback steps, and any required data backfill.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Zero-Downtime Rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for production-safe deployment sequencing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a zero-downtime migration for changing [old field] to [new field]. Include compatibility phases, backfill timing, verification, rollback, and cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complex Data Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before running a risky data transformation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review this data migration plan for safety. Identify transaction boundaries, backup needs, batching risks, NULL handling, rollback gaps, and production monitoring steps.

output_examples.input: Add a required status field to users with a default value.
output_examples.output: A staged migration plan that adds the field, backfills existing rows, verifies row counts, and documents a rollback that removes the field.

output_examples.input: Rename a customer name column without downtime.
output_examples.output: A multi-phase rollout: add the new column, write to both fields, backfill data, switch reads, verify parity, then remove the old column.

output_examples.input: Review a data migration that splits addresses into separate columns.
output_examples.output: A risk review covering backup creation, parameterized updates, malformed address handling, rollback reconstruction, and staging validation.

best_practices: Run every migration and rollback on staging data before production.
Prefer small, reversible steps with transactions when the database supports them.
Create backups and verification checks before destructive schema changes.
anti_patterns: Do not drop or rename production columns before application compatibility is deployed.
Do not migrate large tables in one unbatched operation without monitoring.
Do not skip rollback planning for data transformations or destructive changes.

faq.question: Does this skill run migrations automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides migration guidance and examples that you adapt and run through your normal deployment process.

faq.question: Which ORMs does it cover?
faq.answer: It includes examples for Sequelize, TypeORM, and Prisma, plus general database migration patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with zero-downtime changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes phased rollouts for additive changes, backfills, read switches, and cleanup.

faq.question: Does it replace database backups?
faq.answer: No. Backups, staging tests, monitoring, and owner approval remain required for production migrations.

faq.question: Can it review rollback plans?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help check whether rollback steps, transactions, and checkpoint backups are included.

faq.question: Is it suitable for cross-database migrations?
faq.answer: It can guide compatibility planning and notes differences such as JSON handling in PostgreSQL and MySQL.
